Room is warming: Rack A inlet 30.3C and return air 26.5C both rising ~0.3C/10min. All sensors trusted.

Diagnosis is AC cooling loss (posterior 1.0), breach likely in ~57 min without action.

Action approved: backup cooling for Rack A (takes ~20 min). This cut breach risk from 75% to 0% in simulation, better than shedding load.

Backup cooling supplements building AC, does not replace fire/breaker protection.
